title: Record Cyclotron fit findings for marketing automation
description: Findings from the Cyclotron session and code review (2026-10-20). Good fits: brand-safety/claim checks on generated creative (labels come from the existing approval step), routing inbound replies (needs reply ingestion), lead/intent scoring on Prospectus conversions (if sales outcomes come back as labels). Weak fits: persona tagging (only if someone labels personas), audience segmentation (classifies known labels, does not discover clusters), content-performance prediction (a delayed numeric metric, not a human judgement). Integration: Python SDK (decision_flywheel; Babulus would need a Python worker) or the hosted Lab with Prospectus credentials; reference is Papyrus's relevance sweep. Cost: no per-call fee, only decision-model usage; caching and max_requests cap spend.
